key_insight: The paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure and bonding database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compounds with visible-range gaps and a notable set of half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: This dataset enables faster screening of Cs2BB'X6 materials for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, radiation detection, and spintronic design by linking composition to electronic and magnetic behavior.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations for >2,500 stable Cs2BB'X6 halide double perovskites
Spin-polarized density of states computed for electronic-structure screening
LOBSTER chemical-bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds analyzed, with 719 showing visible-range band gaps and 118 exhibiting half-metallic character.
watch_item: Results are computational predictions based on a stability filter, so experimental validation and synthesis feasibility remain important before device use.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
